page_title: AI Video Maker for Business – Create Videos Faster

summary.name: PromoAI (Promo.com)
summary.one_liner: PromoAI is a web-based AI video maker for businesses that builds marketing, social, ad, and product videos from templates, licensed photos, and chat-based edits.
use_cases: Creating social media and ad videos from templates
Turning Airbnb listing photos into listing videos
Producing multi-client campaign videos for agencies
Planning and scheduling social video campaigns
summary.what_it_does: PromoAI is described as an AI video creation platform that helps plan, generate, and edit promotional videos. It offers ready-made templates, guided storyboards, and idea generation. Users can edit clips, text, and pacing by chatting with the AI, and there is also an online editor for manual refinements. The platform includes planning, scheduling, and publishing to social channels, with AI-generated titles and descriptions. It draws on a media library that the page says includes Getty Images content, with royalty-free licensing and indemnification.
notable: Royalty-free licensed media from Getty Images with uncapped indemnification
Chat-based editing where changes to clips, text, or pacing apply immediately
Multi-client brand management hub for agencies
Airbnb and Amazon product video templates
caveats: The page says 'Try for free' but does not state paid tier details, so pricing beyond a free trial is unclear.
Page is largely marketing copy; feature claims are not independently verified.
